species.tagline: The one cooing downstairs every morning

tasks.title: Find the pearls
tasks.message: The side of its neck is black with white spots, like a string of pearls.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a spotted dove. Its neck looks like it is wearing a string of pearls.

tasks.title: Find the long tail
tasks.message: Its tail is long, and it fans out with white edges when the bird flies.
tasks.subtitle: Its tail is long. When it fans out in flight you can see the white edges.

tasks.title: See the real dove
tasks.hint: Tap the photo on the right
tasks.message: On a real spotted dove you can count every pearl.
tasks.subtitle: This is a photo of a real spotted dove. Drag the slider and count the pearls.

tasks.title: What to do
tasks.message: It startles easily. Walk past slowly and it will stay.
tasks.subtitle: Doves are frightened by noise and chasing. Walk quietly and you can watch longer. Thank you!
